visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a white ramen bowl filled with thin noodles. A pair of silver chopsticks lifts the noodles, showing their texture as steam rises. A soft-boiled egg, slices of pork, and vegetables are visible in the broth. The background is a wooden table with other dishes. (2) A male chef in a black apron and white headscarf is seen in a kitchen pouring broth into a bowl from a metal pot. The lighting is bright and industrial. (3) A view of the restaurant interior shows a long counter with several seated customers. The lighting is warm and dimmed. (4) The camera focuses back on food preparation. Pieces of fried food are handled with chopsticks over a bowl of broth. (5) Detailed shots of toppings like chashu pork, chicken slices, and green vegetables are shown one by one as they are dipped into the soup. (6) A scoop of pale broth is lifted with a white spoon to show its clarity. (7) Stir-fried noodles with seaweed and meat are presented on a white plate, with steam rising actively. (8) Side dishes, including fried dumplings being dipped in a dark sauce and pieces of fried chicken, are displayed in close-up. (9) The chef is shown again stir-frying in a large black wok with intense steam rising. (10) The final scene shows the exterior of the shop at night, with a wooden door and a lit sign featuring Japanese characters.

(6) [Subtitle]: 味道會帶一點清香. (7) [Subtitle]: 炸干貝. [Subtitle]: 炸牡蠣 放在裡面也很搭. (8) [Subtitle]: 搭配豬叉燒 和雞叉燒. (9) [Subtitle]: 還有蔬菜和溏心蛋. (10) [Subtitle]: 口感很豐富. [Subtitle]: 拉麵Q彈. (11) [Subtitle]: 吸附湯汁 吃起來蠻涮嘴的. (12) [Subtitle]: 這裡也能吃到 大蒜豚骨拉麵. (13) [Subtitle]: 他們家的豚骨湯 比較爽口 不會太濃厚. (14) [Subtitle]: 也有附軟嫩的叉燒. (15) [Subtitle]: 日式炒麵也可以試試. (16) [Subtitle]: 現點現炒 是鹹甜的醬香味. (17) [Subtitle]: 配叉燒一起吃 味道還不錯. (18) [Subtitle]: 想加點小東西的話 可以試試香酥鍋貼. (19) [Subtitle]: 外酥裡嫩的 唐揚雞也不錯. (20) [Subtitle]: 這間是師傅 一個人在做餐點 可能要稍微等一下哦. (21) [Slogan]: 島之麵屋拉麵 高雄市新興區開封路130號1樓 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨 下次再一起吃美食囉.
